criteria.description: Exactly one split/copy/h1/description/form/email/submit/legal/terms/poster/trigger/dialog/loader/video and no extra UI
Mobile copy/form then media; desktop media-left/copy-right equal centered columns at 1024px
Form stacks below 640px and becomes growing-email/intrinsic-submit row at 640px
Pristine, single invalid feedback, success status, real action/terms and no-JS native submission
One loading/playable video dialog closes by Escape, close and backdrop with focus restoration
Visible labels/focus, 44px targets, reduced motion, light/dark and axe WCAG 2.1 AA
One root-scoped module and no global selector or framework leakage
